instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and increase the brightness of the image. Save the brightened image as 'character_bright.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing brightness of an image with mean brightness 213.84 (verified by analyzing original). Evaluator checks that output image has mean brightness greater than 213.84, indicating brightness was increased.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires 3 things (open character.png, increase brightness, save as character_bright.png), but evaluator only verifies brightness increase
No verification of input-output relationship: Evaluator cannot distinguish between correctly brightening character.png vs copying any random bright image to character_bright.png
File existence check is weak: Getter only checks if output file exists and has brightness > 213.84, not whether it's derived from the correct input image
Missing semantic verification: A user could pass the test by copying any image with brightness > 213.84 to the output path, without actually completing the task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add image similarity check: Compare structural similarity (SSIM) or perceptual hash between character.png and character_bright.png to verify they are the same image
Add dual-getter verification: Get brightness of both input (character.png) and output (character_bright.png) images, then verify output > input
Add file existence verification: Explicitly check that character_bright.png exists at the correct path as a separate verification step
Consider simplifying instruction to only 'increase brightness' if input-output relationship cannot be verified, or enhance evaluator to check all requirements
